{{Quote|Welcome to the Maw installation, professor. It's a relief to have a weapons engineer of your distinction on staff.|[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]]|<ref name="Death Star Designer">''[[Death Star Designer]]''</ref>}}
An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] worked on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] project in the Maw installation during its final stages of construction, while Bevel Lemelisk received a bacta treatment after being choked by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Behind the scenes==
The engineer was a player's character in an online game [[Death Star Designer]]. Grand Moff Tarkin personally greets him and informs that the chief engineer [[Bevel Lemelisk]] suffered an "unfortunate near-fatal choking", thus making him the head of the project until Lemelisk returns.
